Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied six-item artifact sprite sheet for a fantasy strategy game. Remove ALL magical VFX from ALL six objects: external glow and light bloom, halo, aura, haze, smoke, sparkles, floating dust, stars, lightning, energy trails, loose orbiting light ribbons, light rays and luminous swirls INSIDE gems. Remove the blurred luminous background completely. Deliver a genuine transparent RGBA background, clean alpha edges, no checkerboard painted into the image, no ground shadow. Keep the SAME SIX recognizable physical objects, same faction materials, ornaments and silhouette, same arrangement and approximate scale, each wholly isolated inside its original cell. Layout must remain exactly THREE EQUAL COLUMNS by TWO EQUAL ROWS, landscape 3:2 1536x1024 sheet. Top row: sword / crown / pair of boots. Bottom row: breastplate / ring / heart-shaped quest relic with its physical miniature architectural frame/base. Each item centered in its own 512x512 cell with clear margin; no overlap across cell boundaries, no labels, no text, no frame added. Gemstones must look like non-emissive natural cut stones under neutral diffuse studio light. Preserve sculpted metal sun spikes, leaves, fur, engravings and physically attached solid decorative structures, but remove floating magical ornaments. Render normal material shading and restrained realistic metal reflections only, no white hotspots or magical illumination. Preserve identity and detailed painterly game icon quality; do not redesign the items.
Faction-specific invariants: Retain Nordic silver and dark steel, blue cloth, fur trim, wolf heads, runic engravings. Blue gems are natural non-emissive sapphire/ice-blue stones. No blue lightning, no aurora, no cyan edge light, no galaxy inside any gemstone.
